title: Viddler
description: Official Viddler MCP: list videos, manage access control, pull proof-of-viewing analytics.
summary: Official Viddler MCP: list videos, manage access control, pull proof-of-viewing analytics.
offersHint: Official Viddler MCP: list videos, manage access control, pull proof-of-viewing analytics. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.viddler.com/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: a Viddler Personal Access Token in the form 'Bearer vdl_<prefix>_<secret>'. Create one at https://viddler.com under account settings.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer token: a Viddler Personal Access Token in the form 'Bearer vdl_<prefix>_<secret>'. Create one at https://viddler.com under account settings.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_feedback_submit
toolsPreview.description: File a feature request, bug report, or general feedback to the Viddler team from inside your MCP client. Goes into the same triage queue as the in-app feedback widget. Use category 'feature' for feature requests (the default intent), 'bug' for problems, 'general' otherwise.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_access_set_password
toolsPreview.description: Gate a video behind a secret password. While protected, playback (including embeds) requires the password and Viddler swaps to a Mux signed-playback id. Returns the updated protection state.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_access_remove_password
toolsPreview.description: Turn off password protection for a video. Reverts to the public playback id so the video plays without a password again.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_access_set_custom_url
toolsPreview.description: Give a video a branded, human-friendly custom URL slug for sharing. Returns the updated video.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_analytics_get_views
toolsPreview.description: Return view counts and per-view records for a video: total views, remaining/available views, and the viewer log. The core 'who watched' proof-of-viewing data.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_analytics_account_usage
toolsPreview.description: Return the authenticated account's plan, quota used/remaining, and video count.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_videos_list
toolsPreview.description: List videos owned by the authenticated account.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_videos_get
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full record for one video: status, playback id, duration, moderation, storage state, protection. Poll this after create_upload until muxPlaybackId is no longer 'pending'.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_videos_create_upload
toolsPreview.description: Step 1 of uploading a video. Returns { uploadId, uploadUrl }. PUT the raw video file bytes to uploadUrl (e.g. `curl -X PUT --upload-file video.mp4 '<uploadUrl>'` — no auth header needed, the URL is pre-signed). Then call viddler_videos_register with the uploadId to create the video record. Requires a videos:write token.

toolsPreview.name: viddler_videos_register
toolsPreview.description: Step 2 of uploading a video: after the file has been PUT to the uploadUrl, call this with the uploadId to create the video record. Returns the video (muxPlaybackId will be 'pending'). Poll viddler_videos_get until muxPlaybackId resolves — processing usually takes under a minute. If title/description are omitted, AI generates them from the video content.
